text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following her heart and pouring everything 
she had into it, Ines Fujin conquered the 
Japanese Derby. She proudly claimed the 
title of Derby Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a desperate sprint, she could barely 
even walk. Even so, she headed toward the 
stands to answer the cheering crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Chants of "Ines! Ines!" echoed to 
celebrate her win. Summoning the last of 
her strength, Ines Fujin put her heartfelt 
gratitude into words.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And having danced through the Winning 
Live, she... collapsed to the ground.
